notes.W7161554268: Proves that every complex eigenvalue of a Markov generator is confined by the affinity and eigenvector winding number of some nonequilibrium cycle. Oscillation needs thermodynamic driving, and quantifiably so. Settles the Uhl–Seifert ellipse conjecture and unifies earlier bounds; anyone simulating chemical or biological clocks gets a hard ceiling.
notes.W4416284171: Shows that in Markov jump networks a perturbation acting on one rate gives a steady-state response of fixed sign at any strength, so crude local linear feedback achieves globally stable control. Explains why cells regulate robustly without fine-tuning. Caveat: guarantees weaken when inputs hit several rates at once.
notes.W7236743722: Hollow shells with a single opening filter turbulent eddies by scale, creating fluctuation gradients that pump particles in or out with zero net flow. A ratchet driven by turbulence's nonequilibrium cascade. Works across three orders of magnitude in size and sorts particles differing by tens of nanometres.
notes.W7110625727: A 415-village, 8,300-woman randomised trial: an 80-minute aspiration-setting workshop raised labour supply, investment, revenue and living standards 17 months later versus a placebo workshop. Cross-randomised cash transfers also raised aspirations. A strong design behind a claim that usually rests on correlations.
notes.W4404364922: Single-nucleus multi-omics in 44 human coronary arteries plus Hi-C, CRISPRi and Perturb-seq trace non-coding risk variants to cell states and genes. Variant effects strengthen as smooth muscle cells turn fibromyocyte-like; AMOTL2 emerges as a distal gene. A reusable template for turning GWAS hits into mechanism.
notes.W7239801591: Across 3.6 million Nordic births, prenatal exposure to methylphenidate, amphetamines or atomoxetine was not linked to neurodevelopmental disorders after propensity weighting (HR 1.05, 0.98–1.12). Reassuring for pregnant patients weighing treatment. Caveat: observational, only 7,595 exposed, and prescription fills only approximate actual use.
notes.W4417290488: People with no hand function after cervical spinal cord injury could voluntarily drive individual motor units in paralysed muscles, read with high-density surface EMG, well enough to play Pong and Snake and steer a virtual wheelchair with three independent signals. A non-invasive interface; the sample is small.
notes.W4416948241: A machine-learned force field that treats one excess electron quantum mechanically while learning everything else from DFT. It recovers the solvated electron's reaction with hydronium: activation energy 3.2 kcal/mol and a free energy matching experiment. Opens ML simulation to redox and radiation chemistry.
notes.W4292847479: Three experiments show people weight information others discovered far less than equally relevant information they found themselves, even when they see it with their own eyes. So the failure is in weighting, not in communication. A clean, transferable bias for models of collective learning.
notes.W7239859100: A Chemical Reviews map of nanopore sequencing: how the pore acts as an electrical read head, why it gives long reads and direct base-modification calls, and how it compares with other platforms on accuracy, throughput and cost. Useful grounding as nanopores move into clinics.

thread: Three of today's physics papers turn out to be one story. In the eigenvalue bounds, the feedback-control constraints and the turbulence shelters, what you can extract from a driven system is set by its nonequilibrium cycles, whether that is oscillation, robust regulation or directed particle transport. Separately, the two economics papers agree that beliefs people generate themselves move behaviour more than information handed to them.

notes.W7161554268: Shifts: bounds on oscillation in stochastic networks were a scattered set of inequalities and conjectures → each complex eigenvalue is localised by one cycle's affinity and winding number. This gives a single geometric rule for how dissipation pays for coherent dynamics.
notes.W7125400162: Shifts: catalyst nanoparticles under reaction were assumed to sit in their equilibrium structure and coverage → fast turnovers can trap them in metastable, off-equilibrium states. Structure–activity models built on equilibrium sampling may be describing states the working catalyst never occupies.
notes.W7220376616: Shifts: Green–Kubo relations and Onsager regression held only near equilibrium → transport coefficients can be read from steady-state fluctuations in driven, memory-laden fluids. Active matter gets a first-principles rheology, including negative storage modulus from chemical cycles.

foundation.title: Broken detailed balance is a budgeted resource
foundation.principle: At equilibrium, detailed balance forbids net currents, sustained oscillation and work from fluctuations. Once a system is driven, its cycles carry an affinity, a thermodynamic force, and that affinity is a budget for what the system can do. The Markov eigenvalue paper shows the budget caps how strongly modes can oscillate relative to how fast they decay. The feedback-control paper shows that the same network structure constrains the sign of responses, which makes cheap local control safe. Turbulence shelters spend the nonequilibrium energy cascade to pump particles where a molecular gas could not. The same accounting applies to molecular motors, circadian clocks, kinetic proofreading and catalysts held off equilibrium by turnover.
rests_on: Schnakenberg (1976). Network theory of microscopic and macroscopic behavior of master equation systems
Onsager (1931). Reciprocal relations in irreversible processes. I
Feynman, Leighton & Sands (1963). The Feynman Lectures on Physics
foundation.question: Is there a single inequality linking entropy production to all useful outputs at once (precision, oscillation, control and transport), or are these separate budgets?

W7161554268.question: What limits the complex eigenvalues, and hence oscillations, of Markov generators?
W7161554268.approach: Mathematical proofs relating eigenvalues to cycle affinities and eigenvector winding numbers, for unicyclic and multicyclic networks.
W7161554268.finding: Each complex eigenvalue lies in a region set by one cycle's affinity and winding; this proves the Uhl–Seifert ellipse conjecture.
W7161554268.implication: A thermodynamic tradeoff between driving, oscillation and decay that holds for any Markov model.

W4416284171.question: How do biological networks achieve robust control using only crude, local information?
W4416284171.approach: Derived nonequilibrium response constraints for Markov jump processes, then analysed feedback in a control-theoretic framework.
W4416284171.finding: Single-rate perturbations give monotonic steady-state responses; with one regulator, local stability implies global stability for any topology.
W4416284171.implication: Simple local feedback may be enough for chemotaxis-style adaptation, without fine-tuned network design.

W7236743722.question: Can geometry harness turbulent fluctuations to move particles selectively without net flow?
W7236743722.approach: Built single-aperture hollow shells that filter eddies by scale, tested across three orders of magnitude in size.
W7236743722.finding: Shelters create concentration contrasts; at the microscale they separate particles differing by tens of nanometres, regardless of material.
W7236743722.implication: A new design principle for filtration: compartmentalise fluctuations rather than pump fluid.

W7110625727.question: Do higher aspirations drive investment among people in poverty, and do aspirations respond to income?
W7110625727.approach: 415-village RCT with 8,300 Kenyan women; aspiration workshop cross-randomised with large unconditional cash transfers.
W7110625727.finding: Workshop raised aspirations, labour supply, investment, revenue and living standards at 17 months; cash transfers raised aspirations too.
W7110625727.implication: Cheap psychological interventions belong in development policy alongside cash.

W4404364922.question: Which cell types, enhancers and genes explain non-coding coronary artery disease risk variants?
W4404364922.approach: Single-nucleus RNA/ATAC in 44 arteries, Hi-C in 15, CRISPRi and arrayed Perturb-seq of GWAS enhancers.
W4404364922.finding: 11,269 caQTLs; variant effects vary by smooth muscle state; AMOTL2 nominated; extracellular matrix remodelling is the convergent programme.
W4404364922.implication: A framework for mapping GWAS variants to cell-state-specific mechanisms and drug targets.

W7239801591.question: Does prenatal exposure to ADHD medication raise children's risk of neurodevelopmental disorders?
W7239801591.approach: Nordic register cohort of 3,643,376 children; propensity overlap-weighted Cox models, pooled by meta-analysis.
W7239801591.finding: No increased risk of any neurodevelopmental disorder: weighted HR 1.05 (95% CI 0.98–1.12), consistent across drug types.
W7239801591.implication: Supports continuing ADHD treatment in pregnancy when clinically needed, pending residual-confounding caveats.

W4417290488.question: Can people with no hand function after cervical spinal cord injury control motor units in paralysed muscles?
W4417290488.approach: High-density surface EMG decomposed into motor units; tracking tasks, cursor control, games and virtual wheelchair navigation.
W4417290488.finding: Accurate control plateaued within days, transferred to 2D tasks and three independent signals, even with spasticity.
W4417290488.implication: Non-invasive motor-unit interfaces could drive assistive devices and rehabilitation without implants.

W4416948241.question: Can machine-learned force fields explicitly model an electron's chemistry?
W4416948241.approach: Hybrid scheme: excess electron treated quantum mechanically; short- and long-range interactions machine-learned from DFT.
W4416948241.finding: Solvated electron plus hydronium: proton-transfer recombination, activation energy 3.2 kcal/mol, free energy consistent with experiment.
W4416948241.implication: Extends cheap, accurate ML simulation to electron-transfer and radiation chemistry.

W4292847479.question: Do people learn as much from information others discover as from their own?
W4292847479.approach: Three experiments where pairs learn independently and share information, varying how it is transmitted.
W4292847479.finding: People systematically underweight others' information, even when it is perfectly communicated or directly observed.
W4292847479.implication: Social learning fails partly from weighting bias, not just poor communication.

W7239859100.question: Where does nanopore DNA sequencing stand, and how does it work?
W7239859100.approach: Review of principles, commercial platform components, case studies and comparisons with other sequencing technologies.
W7239859100.finding: Nanopores offer long reads, high speed, portability and direct epigenetic base detection; accuracy remains the main shortcoming.
W7239859100.implication: A reference map for clinical and field adoption of electronic sequencing.

figure_notes.W4416284171: Panel A shows the key result: the steady-state probability at a node changes in one direction only as a single rate is turned up, so the derivative never flips sign. Panel B shows why that matters. Local linear feedback loops then steer the system to its target even from starting points far from it.
figure_notes.W4404364922: Read left to right. Panel a is the study design. The UMAP (b) groups nuclei from 44 arteries into vascular cell types, and c shows each sample's composition. Panels d–e count the enhancer–gene links per cell type. Panel f is the punchline: heritability for cardiometabolic traits concentrates in specific cell types above the dotted significance line.
figure_notes.W4416948241: The setup is a 64-water periodic cell with one proton and one excess electron. Panel b shows how each water's electrons are summarised by Wannier centres. Panel c is the embedding potential the learned environment exerts on the electron, brighter meaning higher energy. Panel d is the resulting quantum electron density, sitting in a cavity among the waters.
figure_notes.W4417290488: Surface EMG from a paralysed forearm is decomposed into individual motor units. Some are 'controllable' (coloured) and some are tonic units firing from spasticity. Each colour is one independently controlled unit. Read along the bottom to see the tasks grow harder, from 1D tracking to 2D cursor control, three bars, then games and wheelchair steering.
